review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We are looking for a highly skilled SAP ABAP Developer with hands-on knowledge in Specific ABAP technologies with consolidation to join our team in Coca-Cola Hellenic Digital & Technology Platform Services (DTPS) and be part of the Data Governance team. The SAP ABAP Developer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Configuration Leads, MDM Product Managers, delivery managers/scrum masters, and architects, to ensure that the solutions meet business requirements and are scalable, secure, efficient, and reliable. o Ability to understand SAP modules with business scenarios and perform ABAP development to fulfill requirements. o Collaborate with product configuration leads/functional consultants and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and implement solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing SAP modules.
